tbesh_html:
1) a precious stone (in the high priest's breastplate)
1a) probably an agate

strongs_1890.strongs_def: a gem (from its sparkle), probably the agate
strongs_1890.derivation: from an unused root (probably identical with that of H7617 (שָׁבָה) through the idea of subdivision into flashes or streamers (compare H7632 (שָׁבִיב)) meaning to flame;
